title: CLUE: Uncovering Social Context for Pragmatic Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.22167v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding a conversation requires connecting what is said to the speakers' relationships, expectations, and earlier exchanges. Prior work shows that supplying relevant context can improve models' social judgments, but much of this information may already be present in the conversation. This motivates training models to discover the cues that matter and use them to support an interpretation. We propose CLUE, a two-stage training pipeline that combines supervised evidence reasoning with GRPO guided by Grounded Information Utilization ($\mathrm{IU}_{\mathrm{G}}$). This reward credits new, evidence-supported social inferences while accounting for reasoning effort. We train on a small set of conversational examples to assess effectiveness and generalization across tasks, languages, and genres. translated_title: CLUE：揭示社会语境以实现语用理解
translated_abstract: 理解一段对话需要将所说内容与说话者之间的关系、期望以及先前的交流联系起来。先前的研究表明，提供相关语境可以改善模型的社会判断，但这些信息中的很大一部分可能已经存在于对话之中。这促使我们训练模型去发现真正重要的线索，并利用它们来支持解读。我们提出了CLUE，一个两阶段训练流程，将监督式证据推理与由扎根信息利用（$\mathrm{IU}_{\mathrm{G}}$）引导的GRPO相结合。该奖励机制在考虑推理工作量的同时，对新的、有证据支持的社会推断给予认可。我们在少量对话示例上进行训练，以评估其在任务、语言和体裁上的有效性与泛化能力。在推理时，训练好的模型能够以自包含的方式对所提供的交互进行推理。与基础Qwen模型相比，CLUE取得了相对（原文在此处被截断）……
tldr: CLUE提出一个两阶段训练流程，将监督式证据推理与基于扎根信息利用（IU_G）奖励的GRPO相结合，使模型能够自主发现对话中关键的社会语境线索，并利用它们提升语用理解能力，同时具备跨任务、语言和体裁的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: CLUE proposes a two-stage training pipeline combining supervised evidence reasoning with GRPO guided by Grounded Information Utilization (IU_G), enabling models to autonomously discover and leverage key social context cues within conversations to improve pragmatic understanding, with generalization across tasks, languages, and genres.
